evidence_rules: Keep local observations separate from published evidence.
Record the source title, publisher, date and URL whenever available.
Do not invent missing measurements, dates, locations or diagnoses.
Do not present uncertain observations as confirmed diagnoses.
Do not turn historical farm practices into automatic treatment instructions.
Prefer current, relevant government and recognized agricultural research sources.
